author: salivan
text:
Hi my friends , tonight i got a PM that allowed me to think a bit more
 about my self ! at first i want to say thank you to that friend for his
 nice PM
 . and then i want to say something about it maybe this can be a PM
from others too. it was about risk of EGO after receive promotion in
every one's life and job and being more humble .it was as some hope and
advice , and i appreciate it , thank you my friend

maybe some one think that i have ego , i hate philosophy but if it's
time for answer this PM it's ok,in my idea there is no difference
between ego and humble .ego is not humble but humble is the same as ego .
 like FTR and FLs .

i don't know if i have ego or if i have humble . but i know some thing
for me . life is simple , if i want some thing so i want it , isn't it ?
 now that i want it ,i have to do every thing that is need to achieve
that ,not every thing that i can. isn't simple ? i don't know your idea
but in mine , yes,it's simple .

maybe it's about asking for sharing knowledge and answering to the
questions, we are here to learn and help each other , if you help others
 then you are master also ,and then you will receive it's badge after
you learnt from helping others with sharing charts .it was the same for
me nothing more nothing less .

but sometimes you can see some people that ask about the basic concepts
 of RTM , and not one time but for several times , and what will be your
 answer ? if you reply him/her like this that "i have no more idea about
 this stuff as i wrote all i knew about it in the forum" , is this ego ?

in my idea no, bcz at first that person should know we are here to help not to repeat every time.

IF wrote all the things that i needed to learn in the forum in every
pages and words ,i just asked one question from him , i can remember
that question also , it was about eng , he didn't answer me , but i
found my answer , bcz i needed that answer and i found it in the forum ,
 can i say that IF has ego ? bcz he didn't answer me ?why i don't want
to ask my self before asking again from IF ? how many times he should
answer the same questions ? i believe that there is no need to repeat an
 answer , but it's need to repeat the question for ourselves then we
will find the answer . don't think that my or others answer to your
question is the best answer , the only answer that is the best is in our
 charts , it's in the market , and this was what IF did for him self and
 readthemarket.com started after that .

in the whole , i don't care about ego and humble, as i don't like philosophy , i like Simplicity.

thanks for a friend that shared this pic with me .

wish you all the best

best regards

Salivan
